items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Philly Joe Jones. Right. Yeah, Lester talked about that gig.

And it's amazing. Philly Joe just starts playing some stuff and he's waiting for someone to come in and Don starts to play a little bit and there's a dialogue going on and Clifford's just sitting there. John Gilmore loved to play drums, too, so you’d see sometimes John would be playing drums.
He’d play that big African drum, too, I know that.
